name: Tag Team Championship
epitaph: PWC's Tag Team Championship was first won by Penance on 8 February 2003. The fed's own record carries 3 reigns on it, across 3 different champions. The longest is Penance's, 56 days from 8 February 2003. Chandler Tsonda held it at the end of the surviving record.

name: World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: PWC's World Heavyweight Championship was first won by Jim Axtell on 13 April 2003. Jim Axtell held it at the end of the surviving record.

name: Television Championship
epitaph: PWC's Television Championship was first won by Hoyt Williams on 3 May 2003. Hoyt Williams held it at the end of the surviving record.
